description: Energy layers and assessments: Palestine is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cesvi Palestine. The dataset contains the full data collected in the field related to energy access. The assessment used the "Beyond Connection" methodology, developed by ESMAP (World Bank). The full sample is based on 210 interviews at the household level in 68 different communities within the Hebron Governorate. All the households are in Area C. Coverage: Palestine. The portal files it under the publisher Cesvi Palestine. Its tags are energy, facilities-infrastructure. The portal shows 2023-05-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
